rationale: Producer recommendation: no operative original order as of 2026-10-14, because EO:14122 §2, signed 2024-04-12; order text states the three EOs are hereby revoked. Exact official original inspected: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2020-03-26/pdf/2020-06478.pdf (SHA-256 b7bcd6db6a8354d93ddd80ce9995e1b7f78e0610b8dba2b1cedec7b364a55629, 85 FR 17001, PDF pages 1-2). Acting original inspected: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2024-04-17/pdf/2024-08332.pdf (SHA-256 d9a37da2e35b80bba55663d0fb093f89c380b06b4409d0f7d419de7c1118b0b7, 89 FR 27355, PDF pages 1-2). This establishes formal revocation at the acting order's signed date, not that this was the earliest clause cessation. For EO13964, EO14148 §2(gg) later revokes EO14029, but does not list EO13964 or state it is restored; the full EO14148 original was checked (90 FR 8237-8241; SHA-256 d658f5158a27f6d4a220ce2ec854bdbd596ecc841fb16884954a2e2ee39ab072). For EO13910/13991/13998, EO14148 does not list EO14122; there is no 14148-to-14122 rescission on the inspected original and thus no revival path to infer. Status remains a producer recommendation only because the complete later-source/reinstatement search through the 2026-10-14 cutoff has not been performed and independent status review remains required.
